subject: P2a: Per-workspace overlay cache
description: Phase 2a (see system note "SPEC: deprecate daemon global workspace pointer"). Replace the single-slot state.overlay cache with a per-workspace Map<ws, overlay> cache in daemon.js. Today targetOverlay returns state.overlay directly when ws===state.workspace "so in-memory state stays authoritative" (daemon.js ~427-432) — this is a write-coalescing cache. Build an equivalent keyed by absolute workspace path so EVERY workspace gets a cached, write-coalesced overlay (not just the global one), with the same save() persistence semantics. All read/write paths that branch on `ws===state.workspace ? state.overlay : overlayStore.load(ws)` switch to the cache lookup. Do NOT yet remove state.workspace (P3) — state.workspace may still seed the cache for back-compat this phase. Preserve correctness of concurrent writes from different workspaces. Keep tests green (test/overlay-*.test.js, workspace-write-target, workspace-read-target). Commit on the attempt branch.

summary: P2a per-workspace overlay cache done. Replaced single-slot state.overlay coalescing cache with a Map<ws,overlay> via overlayFor(ws) in daemon.js. overlayFor(current ws) aliases state.overlay (authoritative, honours test hooks); every other ws is cached, loaded on miss, mtime-invalidated via overlayStamp so out-of-band writes are picked up (no new staleness class). refreshOverlayStamp(ws) re-stamps after the daemon's own save to keep coalescing; targetOverlay.save() calls it. All 8 coherence ternaries rerouted (aggregateCached, targetOverlay, sweepStaleLoops, decideAll sweeps, ctxFor, makeResolver.loadWs, buildGraph, periodic claim-sweep). state.workspace/state.overlay kept for P3. New test/overlay-cache.test.js (10 assertions, all pass). Verified: overlay-cache, overlay-split, overlay-reembed, workspace-write-target (25), workspace-read-target (31, incl. the out-of-band stale-claim sweep), per-ws-sweeps, capacity-fill, spawn-lease all green; full suite 156/166 with only the 10 known pre-existing Windows hook-path failures. Committed 3b4226b on orch/attempt/d7674989-1220-4c98-b891-80ca9e2e803b-2. Not merged — judge+dispatcher handle merges.
